note: Ratchet of the FE GPU / streaming / profiling contract (audits/2026-10-22/fe_gpu_coverage.md). A module leaves 'pending' when it meets every point and enters 'compliant'. The list only shrinks: a new FE module must meet the contract at once.

exempt._basis_cells_ktc: the tuner entry of the device basis-cell path (kernel_tuner fe_basis_cells_device, sweep over the row count against the host variant at 1e-6 equivalence, fallback = the measured row mark, MLFRAME_BASIS_CELLS_DEVICE=0|1 forces a side): it owns no kernel and no array work; the cell kernels and their profile belong to _orthogonal_routing_device and _orthogonal_adaptive_degree_device, which are tracked in this registry as pending
exempt._basis_name_codes: engineered-column name codes and a regular expression that splits a column name; string handling only, no array work
exempt._cat_pair_search_tuner: the tuner entry of _gpu_pairs (cat_pair_search_backend): it owns no kernel, it times the njit pair search against the batched device pair MI of _gpu_pairs, which meets the contract (profile record _gpu_pairs.md)
exempt._composite_group_agg_fe: per-group mean/std/count over integer key codes: a numba kernel bit-equal to pandas (2 ms per 20000-row column, 30 columns x 3 stats in 0.062 s); the candidate scoring that follows is the device-batched CMI (batched_cmi_gpu, chunked on OOM). A device twin would need the pandas Kahan/Welford order replayed per group to stay bit-equal and saves less than its own column transfer (audit 73cm); revisit if the generation share of a fit grows
exempt._conditional_gate_fe_helpers: measured exemption: _scan_gate_column enumerates the (operand, operand, gate) triples and queues them with _add (one quantile grid of 17 thresholds per gate column); the scoring of the queued candidates is the njit prange scan of _conditional_gate_fe, which carries its own entry. Enumeration alone with a no-op queue: 1805 candidates in 3.7 ms (20000 rows, 20 operands, 5 gates) and 12168 in 26 ms (100000 rows, 40 operands, 8 gates) on the host (2026-11-15, min of 5)
exempt._conditional_gate_naming: builds engineered column names and frozen recipe records from strings and floats; no array work, no kernel (carved out of _conditional_gate_fe for file size)
exempt._conditional_quantile_rank_fe: measured exemption: its only consumer is the fe_conditional_quantile_rank_enable region, 0.28 s of a 141 s CPU fit at n=20000 (under 0.5 s, audits/2026-10-22/profiles/fe_family_walls_cpu_n20000.md); a device twin has no payoff at this shape. Re-profile and move it back to pending if the region crosses 0.5 s at another n or column count
exempt._confirm_predictor_engineered: ordering and decision helpers around the single-predictor confirmation: bookkeeping, no numeric kernel
exempt._encoding_recipes: transform-time replay and builder layer of the encoding recipes (kfold target encoding, count, frequency, cat-num residual, cat pair/triple cross): it validates the recipe, extracts ONE source column and hands the stored lookup to apply_target_encoding / apply_count_encoding of _target_encoding_fe and _count_freq_interaction_fe, which stay pending in this registry; no array work of its own
exempt._family_maxt_gate_device: measured exemption: dispatched by data residency, not by a crossover. Resident device batches take the device gate (kernels in _family_maxt_cuda_bits, recorded in its profile), anything else the host gate; on the same family the resident placement is faster at every measured size (20000 rows 0.009 vs 0.013 s, 100000 rows 0.031 vs 0.059, 400000 rows 0.029 vs 0.297; audits/2026-10-22/profiles/_family_maxt_gate_device.md), so there is no region where the other side wins and nothing for a sweep to choose. The module is orchestration over the bit-set kernels (no kernel of its own, no CPU twin: the host gate is _family_maxt_gate). Revisit when the residency scenarios are rolled out (RES11-01): the entry would then be the device-in scenario of the family gate.

The row fill before it is the njit prange kernel, and the MI scoring after it is device-batched

exempt._orthogonal_elasticnet_fe: measured exemption: sklearn ElasticNet coordinate descent on the stacked design matrix, host only, ranking engineered columns by |coef| (a pre-selection option, not a default path); the fit takes 0.017 s for 50 columns at 20000 rows, 0.11 s for 50 and 0.53 s for 200 columns at 100000 rows (GPU 77 C, no throttle); a device proximal-gradient fit would need hundreds of passes over the 80 MB matrix to match the coordinate-descent solution and would not be faster, so no kernel is warranted
exempt._orthogonal_quadruplet_fe: measured exemption: cross-basis products of screened column quadruplets scored by MI uplift, with the device-born scoring routed through the compliant _orthogonal_univariate_fe resident path under STRICT and no kernel of its own; 40 quadruplets at 100000 rows (10 columns) take 0.159 s on the host and 0.106 s under STRICT (GPU 77 C, no throttle), bounded by the quadruplet screen and not by n
exempt._orthogonal_adaptive_arity_fe: measured exemption: adaptive 2..3-way cross-basis tuples scored against their lower-arity subsets, device-born scoring through the compliant _orthogonal_univariate_fe resident path under STRICT, no kernel of its own; 8 columns at 100000 rows take 0.238 s on the host and 0.098 s under STRICT (2.4 times; GPU 77 C, no throttle), bounded by the tuple enumeration of the source columns
exempt._orthogonal_three_gate_mi_fe: measured exemption: three-gate + K-fold out-of-fold MI ranking of engineered columns, per-fold binning and MI with an on-device fold path (_folds_on_device) over the compliant resident MI backends and no kernel of its own; hybrid_orth_mi_three_gate_fe on 8 columns at 100000 rows takes 0.148 s on the host and 0.144 s under STRICT (the fold scheduling, not the MI, dominates; GPU 77 C, no throttle)
exempt._fe_mi_contract: measured exemption: constants and a scalar rounding function (quantize_mi_tiebreak, 0.33 microseconds a call) that pin the cross-backend MI tiebreak contract; no array work, no kernel (GPU 78 C, no throttle)
exempt._orthogonal_shared: measured exemption: host helpers shared by the orthogonal FE families (batched quantile binning, noise-aware floor, y coercion); quantile_bin_batched on 100000 x 50 float32 takes 120.7 ms, noise_aware_floor 3.6 ms and coerce_y_classif 0.68 ms per 100000 values; the device binning twins live in _gpu_resident_select / _mi_greedy_cmi_fe_binning, which carry the kernels and their records (GPU 78 C, no throttle)
exempt._row_stat_fe: measured exemption: row-statistic operator whose pair scan is the parallel njit kernel of _row_stat_kernels on a capped scan sample and pool; row_stat_candidates at 100000 rows takes 0.398 s for 20 columns and 0.466 s for 60 (bounded by MAX_POOL and the scan-row cap, not by n; GPU 78 C, no throttle); a device pair scan would pay a transfer of the standardised pool for a few hundred milliseconds of work
exempt._wavelet_basis_fe_recipes: measured exemption: recipe-application layer of the Haar wavelet FE (generate / build / apply recipes) carved out of the compliant _wavelet_basis_fe, whose batched and fused device paths (_wavelet_legs_fused_gpu, _wavelet_legs_tuner) carry the kernels; generate_wavelet_features over 20 float32 columns at 100000 rows takes 0.117 s (GPU 78 C, no throttle)
exempt._feature_engineering_mem_budget: measured exemption: RAM-budget arithmetic of the FE pair-search shared buffer (hoist or recompute), no array work: _estimate_fe_shared_buffer_bytes 1 nanosecond-scale arithmetic (0.001 ms) and _fe_effective_buffer_budget_bytes 0.008 ms per call
exempt._fe_usability_signal: measured exemption: tail-concentrated linear-usability signal built on a one-pass finite-masked njit |Pearson| (_abs_pearson_njit, parallel-safe, nogil) with a stride subsample for large n; abs_pearson on 100000 float32 values takes 0.093 ms (GPU 78 C, no throttle); the device consumers use their own batched abs-corr kernels (_gpu_batched_abs_corr)
exempt._categorical_encoding: measured exemption: pure-numpy categorical / quantile encoders of the discretisation facade (host factorisation, rare-tail folding, quantile edges), no device work; cap_categorical_cardinality on a 100000 x 50 code matrix with 300 levels per column was 0.333-0.358 s (a strided column read and write of the row-major matrix, 7 ms a column) and is 0.081-0.098 s through transposed 16-column blocks written back by 1024-row tiles, output identical; multi_col_factorize_native of 10 categorical columns takes 4.4 ms (GPU 77 C, no throttle)
exempt._orth_basis_recipes: measured exemption: replay and builder layer of the orthogonal-basis recipe kinds (apply_* / build_* functions, one parallel njit Fourier kernel _fourier_linear_sincos_njit, shared basis evaluation), run at transform time on one column or pair at a time; the heavy fitted work is in the compliant basis modules; no device path in the replay by design (a recipe is a pure function of the source columns evaluated on the host with the fit-time constants, so replay on a prediction frame needs no GPU)
exempt._orth_pair_cross_fe: measured exemption: pair cross-basis products basis(x_i)_a * basis(x_j)_b of screened pairs scored by MI uplift, device-born scoring through the compliant resident cross-basis path (_pair_device_col_specs / _resident_pair_cross_mi) and no kernel of its own; 30 pairs at degree 2 on 10 columns at 100000 rows take 0.389 s generate + score (GPU 77 C, no throttle), bounded by the pair screen and not by n
exempt._unified_fe_gate: measured exemption: Tier-1 local MI floor over the engineered columns (raw MI noise floor by median + MAD, MI of every candidate, top-k), delegating the MI to _orthogonal_univariate_fe._mi_classif_batch and the permutation-null maximum to _orth_mi_null_max (both compliant, with their own kernels and records), no kernel of its own; local_mi_gate on 500 candidates at 100000 rows takes 2.375 s on the host and 0.481 s under STRICT (4.9 times); host cProfile 2.49 s: the null-max MI loop 0.84 s over 39 calls, the njit plug-in MI batch 0.67 s, the rank-binning of the null 0.60 s; STRICT nvprof: null_mi_perms_bits 38.8 percent (98 ms a launch), host-to-device copies 26.7 percent, radix_select_interp_f64_v3 19.4 percent, transpose_f64 6.6 percent, cupy_copy float32->float64 5.1 percent (GPU 79 C, SM 1695/1911 MHz, no throttle); lead OP11-19 in the tracker
exempt.feature_engineering: measured exemption: pair-discovery front end (transformation registries with njit-wrapped host functions, batched device unary / binary appliers, the pairs MI precompute) over the compliant _feature_engineering_pairs kernels and the batched MI backends; the module's own device appliers (apply_gpu_unary_batched / apply_gpu_binary_batched) are 11.9 times (log), 5.5 times (sqrt) and 6.3 times (sin) faster than the host registry on 40 columns of 100000 rows (0.0119 / 0.0116 / 0.0109 s against 0.1419 / 0.0639 / 0.0684 s), and the 17 'medium' unary transforms of one 100000-row column take 22.7 ms on the host; GPU 77 C, SM 1708/1911 MHz, no throttle
exempt._target_encoding_fe: measured exemption: K-fold out-of-fold target encoding whose cost is the host string handling of the categorical columns (arrow-to-numpy, string factorisation, content key of the column-coding cache) with the per-category OOF moments in an njit kernel (_per_cat_centered_moments_njit); kfold_target_encode_with_recipes on 30 string columns (20 / 200 / 2000 levels) at 100000 rows takes 0.58 s (cProfile 0.64 s: kfold fit 0.506 s of which _column_to_str 0.25 s, factorize 0.20 s, the OOF encode 0.128 s over 20 calls, auto-detect 0.124 s), and the strings cannot live on the device; a gather of precomputed codes would move 100000-row key vectors across the bus for a counting pass of a few milliseconds (GPU 77 C, no throttle)
exempt._temporal_agg_fe: measured exemption: leak-safe expanding aggregates and lags per entity over time-sorted history, njit scans (_expanding_stat_past_only_njit, _lag_ring_buffer_njit) plus per-entity history tables stored in the recipes; 5 value columns x (5 expanding stats + 3 lags) = 40 features over 2000 entities at 100000 rows take 0.331 s (cProfile 0.476 s: the recipe history dict building 0.120 s, the entity-sorted lag build 0.057 s, the njit scans 0.028 s over 25 calls, dtype checks 0.046 s); sequential per-entity scans with host-held recipe tables, no device path warranted (GPU 77 C, no throttle); the rolling-window sibling _temporal_agg_fe_rolling has its own device record
